([[Indianapolis|Indianapolis, Indiana]]) | college = * [[Campbell Fighting Camels basketball|Campbell]] (2016–2018) * [[IUPUI Jaguars men's basketball|IUPUI]] (2019–2021) | draft_year = 2021 | career_start = 2021 | years1 = [[2021–22 NBA G League season|2021–2022]] | team1 = [[Grand Rapids Gold]] | years2 = 2022 | team2 = [[Twarde Pierniki Toruń]] | years3 = [[2022–23 NBA G League season|2023]] | team3 = Grand Rapids Gold | years4 = [[2023–24 NBA G League season|2023]]–[[2024–25 NBA G League season|2025]] | team4 = [[Santa Cruz Warriors]] | years5 = [[2025–26 NBA G League season|2026]]–present | team5 = [[Valley Suns]] | highlights = * 2× Second-team All-[[Horizon League]] (2020, 2021) }} '''Marcus Burk''' (born September 27, 1997) is an American professional [[basketball]] player for the [[Valley Suns]] of the [[NBA G League]]. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Campbell Fighting Camels basketball|Campbell Fighting Camels]] and the [[IUPUI Jaguars men's basketball|IUPUI Jaguars]]. ==High school career== Burk attended [[Franklin Central High School]], and led the team to four straight sectional titles.{{cite news |last1=Tannenbaum |first1=Taylor |title=Indy native, IUPUI standout eying NBA opportunity |url=https://www.wthr.com/article/sports/basketball/indy-native-iupui-standout-marcus-burk-eyeing-nba-opportunity/531-e23b8c65-7944-4323-ad91-546e416f7a93 |access-date=November 5, 2021 |work=WTHR |date=July 16, 2021}} As a junior, he averaged 19 points, five rebounds and two assists per game, earning All-Conference honors.{{cite web |title=Marcus Burk signs with Campbell Basketball |url=https://gocamels.com/news/2016/5/3/5_3_2016_2775 |website=[[Campbell Fighting Camels]] |access-date=November 5, 2021 |date=May 3, 2016}} He scored 40 points against [[Columbus East High School]]. In the Class 4A regional semifinals, Burk posted 36 points, though the Flashes lost to [[FJ Reitz High School]], 81–80. As a senior, he averaged 25.3 points, 5.7 rebounds and 2.7 assists and 2.1 steals per game, earning First Team Super Team honors from [[The Indianapolis Star]].{{cite news |last1=Neddenriep |first1=Kyle |title=Insider: 6 players who had strong case for Indiana All-Stars |url=https://www.indystar.com/story/sports/high-school/2016/04/12/insider-6-players-who-had-strong-case-indiana-all-stars/82952172/ |access-date=November 5, 2021 |work=[[The Indianapolis Star]] |date=April 12, 2016}} In April 2016, Burk committed to playing college basketball for [[Campbell Fighting Camels basketball|Campbell]], the first Division I school to offer him a scholarship, though he also received interest from [[Maine Black Bears men's basketball|Maine]], [[Lincoln Memorial Railsplitters|Lincoln Memorial]], [[King Tornado|King]], and [[Saginaw Valley State Cardinals|Saginaw Valley State]].{{cite web |last1=Rominger |first1=Meghan |title=Burk Continues to Set Sights on NBA Dream |url=https://iupuijags.com/news/2020/8/18/mens-basketball-burk-continues-to-set-sights-on-nba-dream.aspx |website=[[IUPUI Jaguars]] |access-date=November 5, 2021 |date=August 18, 2020}}{{cite news |last1=Neddenriep |first1=Kyle |title=Recruiting: Franklin Central's Marcus Burk considering 5 schools |url=https://www.indystar.com/story/sports/high-school/recruiting-central/2016/04/08/recruiting-franklin-centrals-marcus-burk-considering-5-schools/82784312/ |access-date=November 5, 2021 |work=[[The Indianapolis Star]] |date=April 8, 2016}} ==College career== As a freshman at Campbell, Burk averaged 8 points and 2.4 rebounds per game. He was named [[Big South Conference|Big South]] Player of the Week on November 27, 2017, after scoring 33 points against [[UNC Wilmington Seahawks men's basketball|UNC Wilmington]]. Burk averaged 14.8 points and 3.6 rebounds per game as a sophomore. Following the season, he transferred to [[IUPUI Jaguars men's basketball|IUPUI]].{{cite web |last1=Holdaway |first1=Ed |title=Men's Basketball Inks High Scoring Transfer |url=https://iupuijags.com/news/2018/5/9/mens-basketball-inks-high-scoring-transfer |website=[[IUPUI Jaguars]] |access-date=November 5, 2021 |date=May 9, 2018}} On January 25, 2020, Burk scored a career-high 39 points in an 89–85 overtime win against [[Oakland Golden Grizzlies men's basketball|Oakland]].{{cite news |title=Burk, Minnett carry IUPUI past Oakland in 89–85 OT win |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401174453 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200126094710/https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401174453 |url-status=dead |archive-date=January 26, 2020 |access-date=November 5, 2021 |work=[[ESPN]] |agency=[[Associated Press]] |date=January 25, 2020}} Burk averaged 21.3 points and 3.4 rebounds per game as a junior, earning Second Team All-[[Horizon League]] honors. Following the season, he declared for the [[2020 NBA draft]], but ultimately returned to IUPUI.{{cite web |last1=Holdaway |first1=Ed |title=IUPUI's Burk Declares For 2020 NBA Draft |url=https://iupuijags.com/news/2020/4/13/mens-basketball-burk-declares-for-2020-nba-draft.aspx |website=[[IUPUI Jaguars]] |access-date=November 5, 2021 |date=April 13, 2020}} In the offseason, he focused on losing weight, building muscle, and improving his playmaking. As a senior, Burk averaged 21.7 points, 3.7 rebounds, 2.2 assists and 1.8 steals per game. He was named to the Second Team All-Horizon League.{{cite news |last1=Simmons |first1=Jonathan |title=Pacers bring in trio of Hoosiers for Monday's pre-draft workout |url=https://www.indystar.com/story/sports/nba/pacers/2021/07/26/pacers-trio-of-hoosiers-headlines-monday-pre-draft-workout/8093435002/ |access-date=November 5, 2021 |work=[[The Indianapolis Star]] |date=July 26, 2021}} ==Professional career== In October 2021, Burk joined the [[Grand Rapids Gold]] after a successful tryout.{{cite web|title=Grand Rapids Gold Announce 2021-22 Training Camp Roster|url=https://grandrapids.gleague.nba.com/news/grand-rapids-gold-announce-2021-22-training-camp-roster/|website=NBA.com|date=October 28, 2021|access-date=November 2, 2021}} On August 10, 2022, Burk signed with [[Twarde Pierniki Toruń]] of the [[Polish Basketball League]] (PLK).{{Cite web|title=Twarde Pierniki z nowym rzucającym|url=https://plk.pl/aktualnosci/n/22440/twarde-pierniki-z-nowym-rzucajacym.html|website=plk.pl|date=August 10, 2022|access-date=August 22, 2022|language=pl}} On January 26, 2023, Burk was reacquired by the [[Grand Rapids Gold]].{{cite web|url=https://gleague.nba.com/22-23-nba-g-league-transactions|website=gleague.nba.com|title=2022-23 NBA G League Transactions|date=January 26, 2023|access-date=January 26, 2023}} On October 30, 2023, Burk joined the [[Santa Cruz Warriors]].{{cite web|title=Santa Cruz Warriors Announce 2023 Training Camp Roster|url=https://santacruz.gleague.nba.com/news/santa-cruz-warriors-announce-2023-training-camp-roster|website=NBA.com|date=October 30, 2023|access-date=November 8, 2023}} ==Career statistics==
